skill.displayName: Work Productivity Tavily Web Workflow Helper

version.changelog:
- Initial release of the Work Productivity Tavily Web Workflow Helper skill.
- Delivers step-by-step support for replicating and improving popular Tavily 搜索-style workflows on Clawhub.
- Focuses on practical bug fixes, setup hardening, safety, and reliability for agent users and maintainers.
- Produces actionable, reusable checklists, templates, scripts, and workflow artifacts.
- Includes built-in validation steps to ensure outputs meet user requirements and can be immediately actioned.

llm.summary: This is a documentation-only workflow helper with no executable code or persistence, though its activation terms are too broad and may trigger unexpectedly.

dimensions.detail: The workflow explicitly favors local-hardware-friendly scripts, templates, checklists, and CPU-safe approaches, with no requirement to access credentials, local profiles, private indexes, or privileged APIs.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown and YAML only; no executable scripts, dependency installers, remote payload loaders, or install-time mutation behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill uses broad trigger words such as web, search, api, user, and bug fix, and agents/openai.yaml allows implicit invocation, so it may be routed into unrelated conversations even though the behavior is only advisory.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanism, memory writing, scheduled task, background worker, privilege escalation, credential/session handling, or tool wrapping was present in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is to help with Tavily-style web/search workflow planning, hardening, reliability, checklists, analysis, and related implementation support; inspected artifacts align with that purpose and do not add hidden capabilities.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: This skill is reasonable to install for Tavily or web-search workflow support, but users should be aware it may activate on generic web/search/API requests unless the platform or publisher narrows the triggers or disables implicit invocation.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad trigger and implicit-invocation concern is artifact-backed and should be corrected, but it does not justify a Review verdict by itself because the skill is documentation-only and does not request high-impact authority.
[SQP-3] expected: The mixed English/Chinese localization is visible in the artifacts and appears to be a documentation quality issue rather than hidden behavior or a security-relevant language constraint.
[AIG-SARIF] expected: A.I.G reported no security results, which is consistent with inspection showing no executable code, exfiltration path, persistence, or privilege mechanism.
